filled.light_entering_denser_medium_n_n_refra: Light donyo i denser medium (n₁ < n₂). Refracted ray gol I NGET ki normal — light mot i dense medium.
filled.light_entering_less_dense_medium_refra: Light donyo i less-dense medium. Refracted ray gol WOKO ki normal — light yot i light medium.

filled.your_hypothesis_where_exactly_does_tir: Hypothesis ni (kabedo ma TIR cakke, dok pingo diamond TIR matek loyo glass?)

filled.why_is_there_no_critical_angle_when_go: Pingo pe tye critical angle ka icito ki less-dense o more-dense?
filled.set_water_air_n_1_33_n_1_00_what_s_the: Ket water→air (n₁=1.33 n₂=1.00). Critical angle en ango? Pingo rec neno lobo ma kigolo i cone malo?
filled.in_a_rainbow_why_does_red_bend_less_th: I rainbow, pingo red gol manok loyo blue? Rib ki wavelength slider.
filled.how_does_a_prism_separate_white_light_: Prism poko white light nining ka wavelengths ducu lubo Snell's law marom?
filled.i_can_explain_why_this_n_n_combination: Atwero tito pingo n₁/n₂/θ combination man kelo refraction state man.
filled.inquiry_widget_no_score_no_reveal_no_a: Inquiry widget — pe score, pe reveal, pe answer dump. Dispersion model tye me nyuto lok (Cauchy-like first-order); dispersion curves me ada gin material-specific (Sellmeier coefficients).
